statement: The input is a Python 3 function that is meant to return how many of the integers in the list xs are even. It contains exactly one bug: an off-by-one, a wrong operator, or a wrong initial value. Fix the bug, then evaluate the corrected function for the call `count_evens([14, -38, 10, -12, 44, 18, 22, 28, 30, 35, -42, 24, 0, -28, 27])`. Answer with the integer it returns.
title: Blue belt: fix count_evens
